title: Government maps, source checks and confirmed changes
shared: These views help readers move from a government body or source check to the dated evidence for a change. The broad map provides entrances; each campaign and subject study retains its own findings and cutoff.
keep_distinct: Keep map coverage, website access, unreviewed candidates, legal instruments, implementation and observed outcomes separate. A later sweep does not update an older campaign’s evidence date, and a monitor lead does not become a finding by appearing here.

tools.title: Government-Wide Research Hub (Federal Government Movement Atlas)
tools.why: Move from the saved government map to dated changes and their controlling studies.
